entries.label: Culturally sensitive place
entries.description: A place whose Traditional Owners, custodians or land council asked that its exact position not be published, such as a sacred site or a place of restricted cultural knowledge. OTWD does not ask them to explain why.

entries.label: Threatened species
entries.description: A place where publishing the exact position could expose a threatened plant or animal to disturbance, collection or other harm, as a land manager or wildlife agency advises.

entries.label: Breeding wildlife
entries.description: A place next to a nesting, roosting or breeding area that visitors would disturb if they could find it, such as a seabird or turtle nesting beach, as a land manager or wildlife agency advises.
